text:
kevin_sales: Heads-up  FinCorp procurement wants ISO/ISMS artifacts to greenlight a 2-week POC. They asked for scope, SoA/applicability statement, and redacted policy PDFs. Need this today.

nina_sec: Confirming: POC will hit our hosted API? That changes the scope language (hosted vs on-prem).

kevin_sales: Yes hosted. Data will be sample invoices with PII. No model uploads.

nina_sec: OK. We can assemble a sales bundle: short ISMS scope statement, one-page SoA applicability table (controls -> Applicable/Partial/N/A), redacted policies (Access Control, Crypto, Incident Response, Backup), and a one-page POC dataflow diagram. No raw workpapers without legal sign-off.

raj_eng: I'll produce the POC diagram showing ephemeral API keys, TLS, platform KMS, and logs to SIEM. Will also note that weights are not stored and tenant isolation is enforced. ETA 2h.

mia_poc: I can create a scoped POC org and limited API key. Procurement also asked whether the ISMS explicitly excludes customer-managed on-prem deployments.

nina_sec: We'll add explicit sentence: "ISMS covers Redwood's hosted and Dedicated control planes and inference services; excludes customer-managed on-prem deployments and customer-controlled model artifacts."

cert_bot: Certificate link: <https://vendors.redwood.com/certs/iso27001-2025.pdf> (sales-team access) :white_check_mark:

nina_sec: Uploaded draft bundle to /shared/sales/FinCorp_ISO_bundle_redacted.zip. Please review.

kevin_sales: Reviewing now. If all good I'll upload to their vendor portal and confirm procurement unblock.

raj_eng: Diagram added to bundle. Included log retention and key handling notes.

mia_poc: POC org ready. Waiting for bundle to be uploaded.

kevin_sales: Procurement replied: "Redacted docs acceptable, please proceed with onboarding." Uploading now. Will close when done.

nina_sec: If they request deeper evidence for specific controls, escalate to compliance for a scoped response.

kevin_sales: Thanks team, closing thread after portal upload.
